描述_EN: hornby hobbies ltd. scalextric were first produced in the late 1950s. additional vehicles could be collected, and tracks from different sets joined together. bought a license to produce the merchandise for both the olympic and paralympic games, and for team gb. they promoted many special olympic editions of games, toys, and collectibles. kits typically included enough track to make a complete circuit, and two miniature models of popular vehicles. in the late 1990s, micro scalextric was a new, smaller version of the racing game, produced at 1/64 scale. this velodrome cycling set is a special edition of the familiar scalextric racing game, produced as merchandising for the london 2012 olympic games. the choice of a cycling version of this micro scalextric game may have been inspired by the success of the british cycling team at beijing in 2008, and the building of a new velodrome in london.
描述_ZN: Hornby hobbies ltd. scalextric最早生产于20世纪50年代末。 可以收集更多的车辆，并将不同套装的轨道连接在一起。 买下了为奥运会和残奥会以及英国队生产商品的许可证。 他们推广了许多特别的奥运版本的游戏、玩具和收藏品。 套装通常包括足够的轨道来制作一个完整的电路，以及两个流行车辆的微型模型。 在20世纪90年代末，微型scalextric是一种新的、更小的赛车游戏版本，以1/64比例生产。 这个velodrome自行车套装是我们熟悉的scalextric赛车游戏的特别版，作为2012年伦敦奥运会的商品。 这个微型scalextric游戏的自行车版本的选择可能是受到英国自行车队在2008年北京奥运会上的成功以及在伦敦建造一个新的自行车场的启发。
